preconditions.description: The input string s has length between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s contains only lowercase English letters.
The integer k is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (len(s) % k == 0 and all(s[i * part_len:(i + 1) * part_len] == s[i * part_len:(i + 1) * part_len][::-1] for i in range(k))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output YES if the string s can be split into k equal-length substrings where each substring is a palindrome; otherwise output NO. The length of each substring is len(s)/k, which must be an integer.
